The maintenance window is **Saturday, December 5, 02:00–05:00 UTC** for the Postgres 17 production cutover [3].

For your notice and support macro:
- **Customer notice:** scheduled for Saturday, November 28, via status page and in-app banner [3].
- **Migration freeze:** starts Thursday, December 3 [3].
- **Staging rehearsal:** Friday, November 27 [3].

This replaces the previously announced November 21 window; KES-398 is the current reference because the Notion runbook has not been updated [3][6].
